item.title: Pontiac mental health facility changes hands early after funding dispute, 155 workers laid off
item.description: A decades-long partnership between Common Ground Resources and Crisis Center and Oakland Community Health Network ended abruptly this month over funding disputes, forcing 155 employees into change.

item.title: School Closings: List of Friday closures amid dangerous cold weather
item.description: Several schools in Southeast Michigan will be closed on Friday as dangerous cold weather continues..

item.title: Kane passes Modano for most points by US-born NHL player in Red Wings' shootout loss to Capitals
item.description: Patrick Kane became the highest-scoring United States-born player in NHL history in the Detroit Red Wings' loss to the Washington Capitals, who got the decisive goal from Nic Dowd in a shootout.
